deactivateDevice(bytes32).details: Callable by the device owner or the contract owner.

isActive(bytes32).details: Returns false for unregistered device IDs.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

reactivateDevice(bytes32).details: Callable only by the device owner.

registerDevice(bytes32,bytes,string).details: Reverts if `deviceId` has already been registered.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

getDevice(bytes32).notice: Return full information for a registered device.

isActive(bytes32).notice: Returns true if a registered device is currently active.

registerDevice(bytes32,bytes,string).notice: Register a new IoT device for the caller.
